name: Grande Ronde River
blurb: Remote northeast Oregon canyon trip with easy water — a good first multi-day float.

sections.notes: Usually 2–3 days. A free self-issued river permit is required. The Wenaha River comes in at Troy. Few roads, so plan your shuttle ahead.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board and managing-agency access guidance
putInAccess.note: The OSMB feature labels the waterway Minam River, but the managing park agency identifies this as the Wallowa River Minam Station launch at Highway 82. Satellite review matches the west-bank launch facility; it is not the remote campground.
putInAccess.directions: Use Minam Station boat launch at Highway 82. Do not route to the separate upstream campground. Arrange the remote takeout shuttle before launching.

takeOutAccess.operator: Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Agency marker locates the access facility beside the bridge, not the bridge itself or a guaranteed landing edge.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Troy. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

mapAuditNote: Agency source and satellite facility review completed 2026-10-29. Only sections with two documented access sites and a separate section approval are shown; approximate markers do not establish an exact landing or river path.
